asset: Forest sample original male swordsman direction/state atlas
authorship: New image generation from this project’s original character specification. No downloaded sprites, game screenshots or existing character images were supplied.
designBrief: Adult male hand-painted miniature 2.5D RPG swordsman; ink-black tied hair; ivory cross-collar tunic, indigo narrow sleeves and split coat; short crimson cape and sash; dark boots; independent readable right-hand longsword; warm upper-left daylight and cool teal shadow. Front/back/left/right columns; idle/walk/contact-slash rows; no scenery or ground shadows.
technicalProcessing: Copied original PNG unchanged into atlas.png.
Encoded RGBA-identical lossless WebP with exact=True; no repaint, retouch, alpha cleanup or per-frame scale changes.
Measured visible alpha bounds at threshold32 because near-transparent generation-edge pixels exist.
Reviewed individual feet/stance and stored pixel anchors inside each unchanged cell.
Made an explicitly diagnostic 62px contact sheet on a flat forest-colored background; not a game capture.
frameKind: 12 direction/state keyposes, not a complete inbetweened animation sequence
